title: Highly recommended
text: We had an excellent experience with Jordi as our (almost) personal tour guide.  Loved the small group experience as it definitely felt more personal as opposed to being lost in a crowd.  He had a visual map to show us at the start of our tour to give us a visual as he spoke about the history of northeastern Spain and I found that very helpful.  He had great knowledge and an excellent command of the English language.  If you love medieval towns, this is very much worth doing.  The second stop in Rupit has a few short hiking trails that are worth doing if you enjoy hiking and differing views.  S
author: C4912EAnancys

title: Highly recommend Jordi and his amazing tour
text: This was a fantastic experience where you get to see the "not so well traversed areas" surrounding Barcelona.  We love medieval towns and this gave us a really wonderful view of Besalu, Rupit and Tavertet, small towns that have retained that medieval feel to them.  Jordi was an excellent guide and his small group tour gave us a really personal experience.  He is very knowledgeable and I appreciated his visual map which helped me make sense of the history he presented at the start of the tour. author: Nancy_S

title: Don’t miss how to get out of Barcelona and see the real Catalonia
text: Jordi knowledge of the history for the area especially the Catalonia people was fantastic. Walking the villages give you a feeling of the medievals times . We enjoyed the everything Jordi had planned for a wonderful day
author: John_M

title: Exclusive yet inclusive
text: It was amazing! The views were breathtaking and our guide Jordi knew a lot about everything to see, but also about the historical, cultural and culinary context. The whole tour was accessible to me as a wheelchair user and the wheelchair could just come along.

author: miguelaM9988BW

title: Excellent tour with exceptional guide.  High recommendation
text: Jordi is an exceptional guide on this exceptional tour.  He knows many interesting details that add depth and breadth to this medieval towns tour and he communicates perfectly in many languages.  He is an excellent guide and he is also a pleasant and professional companion that makes the entire day a complete success
author: Michael_P

title: A wonderful day trip with an experienced guide
text: Jordi is an experienced, knowledgeable guide. We asked him many questions on a range of topics from history to language to culture to politics and he answered them all. The trip was expertly planned and definitely a highlight. We chose the trip for the villages, which were great, but the scenery in the nature preserve was so spectacular that ended up being our favorite part.
author: Tracy_T

title: Oh my gosh the best Tour with good friends
